titleEn: It Will Float Even with Messy Folds

pages.text: Today, they would float paper boats on the river. Each child received one sheet.
Duri folded the paper in half. Duri's boat would go farthest.
Halfway through folding, Duri went to gather stones. The paper lay half-folded.
Duri returned and pressed the boat's front carelessly. "It will float even with messy folds."
The children gently set their boats on the water. Four boats floated side by side.
Duri's boat opened at the side. Water gulped into it.
Duri's boat sank sideways. Duri sat by the water with knees up.
Teacher Bau gave Duri a dry sheet. "Press the folds firmly, and water will not get in."
Duri folded all the way to the end, pressing every crease with a fingernail.
Duri's boat glided out onto the water. Five boats floated downriver side by side. The children waved.
